limitations: The analyses used cohorts of European ancestry, so caution is necessary before generalizing the findings to other populations.
MR instruments may not fully capture the time-varying nature of exposures such as lifetime smoking patterns.
The longevity outcome does not capture all age-related processes.
MVMR cannot assess potential biases due to sources of pleiotropy via all pathways influencing longevity.
Sample overlap across sourced GWASs may bias results.
The cross-sectional nature of the primary transcriptomic data limits inference about the direction of effect between smoking behavior and gene-expression changes.

paper.label: CausalMultiomicsAgingPaper
limitations: Human proteomic analyses were derived exclusively from female participants and in vivo experiments were conducted in female mice, so the impact on male subjects remains speculative.
The high bone affinity and rapid systemic clearance of bisphosphonates make detecting accumulation in nonskeletal tissues technically challenging.
In vitro internalization data may not fully replicate complex in vivo biodistribution.
Low-dose pro-growth effects were observed in highly reductionist systems lacking immune surveillance, stromal interactions and tissue-level homeostatic mechanisms.
There is no solid clinical evidence confirming the role of bisphosphonates on cancer progression.
PHB2 and ASAH1 may not be primary targets for risedronate or alendronate.
The binding profile of zoledronate may vary across noncardiac cell types.

Lectin microarray analyses do not fully resolve the relative contributions of epithelial cell-surface glycans versus mucus-associated mucin glycans.

limitations: Quantifying the age of the transcriptome is challenging and estimates of transcriptional rejuvenation ranged from 20 to 40 years.
The transcription clock required batch correction to compare with reference aging datasets.
The study could not exclude a minor subset of cells with pluripotent-like characteristics.
The effect of starting donor age remains to be explored.
Telomere length was unaffected by MPTR.
Individual migration responses were variable, with some samples unaffected.
